description: A number next to its target does not tell you whether it is good. 92 against 100 is a crisis in one KPI and a great month in another. A table makes the reader do the subtraction, a gauge spends half a page on one value, and a clustered bar chart puts actual and target side by side without ever saying how far apart they are. Bullet Chart Pro puts each actual against its target on one line: the bar is the actual, the marker is the target, the grey bands behind say how far from good the value is, and the variance — amount and percentage — is calculated by the visual, coloured green or red. No DAX measure for the variance. One row per region, product or team, so twenty of them fit where a single gauge used to sit. ACTUAL AGAINST TARGET, AT A GLANCE • Automatic variance: Actual minus Target and the % of the target, with ▲ ▼ and your own green/red threshold • Qualitative bands (poor, fair, good) as percentages of the data maximum • Number formats from your model, including dynamic format strings and calculation groups, in the report language • Six style templates: Clean, Minimal, Contrast, Soft, Compact and an IBCS-inspired monochrome style • Two reference lines, a colour per category and conditional formatting (fx) on the bar colour • Small tiles stay readable: the values column keeps what fits for every row, and the tooltip always has the full figures • Cross-filtering, bookmarks,…
